_doc: 紅楠 second crown form for the hillside Forest Mix V0 (ACW_TG_PARAMS for tools/treegen/machilus_thunbergii.py / machilus_game.py). Same species, leaves, atlas and materials as the PR #30 golden; only the branch / crown architecture changes: a lower, broader, lopsided, looser crown (fewer, larger foliage clumps with deeper gaps), lower fork, 4 spreading limbs, leaning trunk - the shape of a slope-grown / light-gap 紅楠 rather than the open-grown dome.
